$comment: Which architecture doc covers which code. Read by scripts/check-docs.mjs,
which reports when an area changed and its doc did not.
Prefixes, matched against repo-relative paths from `git diff --name-only`.
A file may map to more than one doc; every match is reported.
Keep this honest rather than complete: a mapping that fires on changes the
doc does not actually describe trains you to ignore the warning, which is
the only failure mode that matters for an advisory check.

api-and-caching.md.covers: The apiFetch boundary, the caching model, DTO mapping, error-status mapping

ci-cd-pipeline.md.covers: GitHub Actions, tiering, the ci-success gate, and local CI parity

authentication.md.covers: Email + code login, Google OAuth, token handling

user-roles.md.covers: RBAC: the three roles, JWT claims, endpoint authorisation

llm-api-key-management.md.covers: How the OpenAI key flows without being logged or baked into an image

database-lifecycle.reason: Migrations, seeding and role grants are governed by a skill, not a doc. Read it before changing these.
